Daily

Hourly
The value of an order is calculated as the price per hour multiplied by the number of hours of rent (can be specified accurately to within 5 minutes).

Weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly
In these modes (cyclic orders), the value is calculated as the price per one period (week, month, quarter or year) multiplied by the number of periods that have begun.
